integrity: Exact analytic finite-matrix proof with standalone symbolic and independently recomputed finite energy checks; numerical constants are algebraic root approximations.
scientific_limitations: Weak blocking forbids immediate lowering, not later downhill moves after neutral exchanges; no dynamical relaxation laws, no fixed-magnetization claims, no r=0 novelty. Non-exhaustive priority search and no independent audit.
scope: Labelled periodic Ising spins; fixed ferromagnetic J>0 and r>0; n>=6; no fixed-magnetization constraint; nearest-neighbor unequal-spin exchanges with no strictly energy-lowering move.
title: An isolated weak-exchange blocking entropy spike in ferromagnetic second-neighbor Ising chains
